summary: A phone-sized scrollable frame holding a hero (eyebrow, heading, lead, filled Button) and a second section, with a switch for 200% text and a long translation and a switch for a continuation cue.
use: Showing that a hero is a floor (min-height) so larger text grows it instead of clipping, and that without a visible cue the next section can read as the end of the page.
spec: `<Switch bind:checked={large} label="Text at 200% and a long translation" />` swaps the title to the h2 token and the lead to a longer string
`<Switch bind:checked={cue} label="Continuation cue (peek at the next section)" />` toggles a `.is-peek` class on the second section
The frame is `inline-size: min(100%, 22rem)`, `block-size: 26rem`, `overflow-y: auto`, `tabindex="0"`, `role="region"` with an `aria-label`
`.hero` uses `min-block-size`, never `height`; `<Button variant="filled">See how it works</Button>` is the primary action

The second section is `

How it works

` with one paragraph, separated by a `border-block-start`
